evidence_quotes: geweigerd handhavend op te treden tegen het bouwen van een bouwwerk zonder omgevingsvergunning
rationale: The decision concerns a municipal refusal to take enforcement action against the construction of a building structure without a general building/environmental permit (omgevingsvergunning) on a parcel in Boskoop. It is a general spatial planning and building-permit enforcement dispute with no water law, water utility, or water governance subject matter.
